name: CPCV Purged-Path Lower Bound
note: An arming gate, not a signal generator. Every `refit` bars it takes the trailing window of the base rule's OWN completed hypothetical trades, cuts it into N contiguous groups, enumerates all C(N,2) held-out pairs, purges training bars whose H-bar label window touches a test block and embargoes the bars just after it, picks the breakout lookback on the purged training portion only, scores it on the test blocks, and recombines the splits into phi = k*C(N,k)/N complete out-of-sample paths. It trades the majority-selected lookback only while the WORST path is above min_sr and a bootstrap lower bound over the path Sharpes clears p05_sr. Sharpe here is per-trade (mean/std of trade returns), so the paper's annualised 0.5 does not carry over and the threshold is swept instead. Position sizing by SR_p05/SR_median cannot be expressed -- share count is fixed by the shared harness.
source: Lopez de Prado, M. (2018), 'Advances in Financial Machine Learning', Wiley - ch.7 (purged K-fold with embargo, snippets 7.1-7.4) and ch.12 (Combinatorial Purged Cross-Validation, number of paths phi[N,k] = k*C(N,k)/N). Also Lopez de Prado, 'Backtesting II', Cornell ORIE 5256 lecture 6, https://ssrn.com/abstract=3261943
